meta.title: FreeLLMAPI model pool
meta.description: Drives free-tier models from many providers inside the DSH process: quota-aware routing, automatic failover, region probing and reasoning-effort translation — with no external gateway to run.

config.enabled: Whether to enable the plugin (false registers no provider route)
config.displayName: Name shown in the model picker
config.dataDir: Directory for sealed keys, usage and retirement records; empty means ~/.dsh/freellmapi
config.recovery: Empty-answer recovery: ask once more when a model spends its whole output budget thinking (enabled / totalTimeoutMs / maxOutputTokens)
